title: 'PM Modi or Amit Shah don't have guts': Rahul turns up heat amid Parliament showdown
content: Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi reiterated that the Union home minister Amit Shah must make a statement on police action against students protesting against NEET paper leak. The Congress leader said apart from Amit Shah's statement PM Modi should apologise for what happened and he called for an accountablity over the donation theft in Ayodhya Ram Mandir.  Rahul said opposition was not "interested in Amit Shah's fantasy conversations".

title: For India, the Mecca pact is a setback. For China, it's a warning
content: A new defense pact between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey has been signed. This agreement is seen as a setback for India's regional interests. China may benefit commercially from increased weapon system access. However, the pact could also reduce US military focus in West Asia. This shift might allow greater US attention on China's growing influence.

title: Indian-origin teenagers Bodhana, Shreyas become British chess champions
content: Indian-origin chess prodigies Bodhana Sivanandan, 11, and Shreyas Royal, 17, won the women’s and open titles at the 2026 British Chess Championships. Bodhana became the youngest British women’s champion, while Royal secured his first open title. Both have risen rapidly in chess, with Bodhana earning multiple honours and Royal becoming England’s youngest grandmaster at 15.

title: Beyond fighter jets: India is building a new family of engines for missiles and drones
content: India has successfully developed a 350 kg class expendable turbojet engine for missiles.  The nation also demonstrated a 5 kN thrust class rotating detonation engine.  This engine technology promises faster and longer-range missile capabilities.  These advancements position India among select nations with advanced propulsion systems.  Future applications include drones and launch vehicle upper stages.

title: Google Drive ends Photos backups starting August 10: What users need to do
content: Starting August 10, 2026, the Google Drive desktop app will no longer support backup for Google Photos. Users are encouraged to switch to the dedicated Google Photos app for ongoing folder backups. Rest assured, all previously backed-up photos will remain intact during this transition. This change is aimed at streamlining backup processes and improving photo organization, leaving casual mobile users largely unaffected by this update.

title: Brad Pitt's quote on love, loss and the risk of loving deeply
content: During promotional discussions for 'The Curious Case of Benjamin Button', Brad Pitt explored the delicate interplay of love and loss, highlighting the risks entwined within these emotions. His journey began in Missouri, shaped by a strict upbringing and a passion for drama developed in school. Pitt’s ascent in Hollywood began with his breakout role in 'Thelma & Louise', leading to a career filled with blockbuster hits and financial success.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's $300m yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued
content: Mark Zuckerberg's superyacht Launchpad faced criticism after a reported failure to assist a stranded boat. The vessel's crew explained they were on a different radio channel and help was already en route. A cruise ship eventually towed the disabled skiff safely back to Farragut Bay. Passengers aboard the cruise ship reportedly booed the yacht after hearing the announcement.

title: Woman’s lover hacks her husband 17 times with axe, injured in encounter
content: In a shocking crime of passion, a man named Talib was brutally attacked seventeen times with an axe by Aasim, the alleged lover of his wife. Following a tense shootout, police apprehended Aasim, who later confessed to the horrific act. Authorities have charged him and Talib's wife with murder and conspiracy, while the murder weapon has been secured as evidence.

title: Man travels 1,700 miles and makes 52 calls to save remote UK phone box
content: William Arnold embarked on a mission to save a secluded phone box on a distant island. To meet Ofcom's operational requirements, he placed fifty-two calls, ensuring that the kiosk remains available for another year. His dedication underscores the vital role public call boxes play in isolated communities, urging others to engage with and support these local resources.

title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife MacKenzie Scott returns to writing with 80K-word novel
content: Philanthropist MacKenzie Scott is returning to fiction writing after a thirteen-year hiatus. She will serially release her new novel, 'Last Days in Two Nations,' throughout August. Scott studied creative writing at Princeton University under Toni Morrison. She has given away over twenty-six billion dollars to numerous charitable organizations. Her current net worth stands at thirty-three point eight billion dollars.

title: Brazil footballer falls into tunnel while celebrating goal, suffers injury - Watch
content: Jacy, 29, was celebrating after heading Coritiba into a 2-0 lead against Chapecoense in the 41st minute of their Brazilian Serie A match. The defender picked up the ball and ran towards a group of supporters, jumping as he celebrated.

title: India diversifies energy sourcing; taps 15 countries for LNG, 41 for crude
content: India is expanding its energy import portfolio for both LNG and crude oil, striving to diminish reliance on any singular market or transport path. Additionally, the government is boosting domestic crude oil storage with new infrastructure. These strategies equip India to better handle supply interruptions and market fluctuations, ultimately strengthening the nation's resilience to global energy shocks.

title: Bengaluru 5 hotels raided, Mumbai eateries face action
content: Food safety regulations are having a moment in Maharashtra and Karnataka, with enforcement efforts stepping up significantly. Officials stumbled upon unlicensed vendors and alarming levels of unsanitary conditions, including rotten meat and expired dairy products. In Bengaluru, hotels are facing consequences for issues like poor labeling and inadequate food storage. Authorities are bolstering checks following numerous public complaints about food quality.

title: ONGC, Shell Energy India sign MoU to explore deepwater blocks, LNG sourcing opportunities
content: ONGC and Shell Energy India have entered into a memorandum of understanding to collaboratively delve into potential joint ventures. Their focus will be on assessing opportunities in deepwater and ultra-deepwater oil and gas exploration, alongside investigating LNG sourcing alternatives to bolster India's economic framework. This strategic partnership is designed to improve energy accessibility while ensuring long-term energy security for the nation.

title: 'Need conducive environment': Bangladesh PM on India ties as Hasina eyes return
content: The Prime Minister's Office said Rahman "emphasised the need to create a conducive environment to further advance the bilateral relations between the two countries". Dhaka also called on New Delhi to expedite Hasina's extradition, according to the statement Hasina has been living in India since the fall of her government. She faces legal proceedings in Bangladesh and was sentenced to death in November.

title: Australia U19’s Neel Patel ready for India challenge: ‘Wickets will be different’
content: Australian U-19 all-rounder Neel Patel, who has Indian roots, is relishing the opportunity to tour India. From balcony cricket with his grandfather to representing Australia, Patel speaks about his evolving batting, love for off-spin and his plans to adapt to India’s heat, spin and challenging conditions.

title: Elon Musk net worth 2026: World’s richest person added over $800 million per day
content: Between 2025 and 2026, Elon Musk's fortune saw remarkable growth, accumulating billions as a result of SpaceX's impressive stock performance. Despite heightened spending on artificial intelligence initiatives, the company reported solid revenue and significantly reduced losses. The concentration of wealth among technology giants remains staggering, with the U.S. at the forefront. By 2029, SpaceX is on track to surpass one trillion dollars in revenue.

title: Can Keely Hodgkinson win historic European 800m hat-trick after Olympic glory?
content: Keely Hodgkinson seeks a historic third European 800m gold medal in Birmingham.  She faces strong competition from Audrey Werro and Femke Bol.  Hodgkinson views a home victory as special as her Olympic success.  She considers her Stockholm defeat a sign of developing competition.  The women's 800m final is scheduled for Friday evening.

title: Ramayana star Rakul Preet Singh stuns in Rs 75,000 mustard floral anarkali
content: Rakul Preet Singh, along with husband Jackky Bhagnani, attended the star-studded celebration marking 15 years of IIMUN, joining names like Boman Irani, P.T. Usha, Ravi Dubey, and Saina Nehwal at the event. For the occasion, the actress opted for a mustard floral Anarkali by designer Astha Narang, priced at Rs. 75,000, paired with traditional gold-toned accessories and soft, festive glam.

title: No roads, drainage after 11 yrs: Why Gr Noida ‘smart village’ wants name change
content: Sadullapur village, designated a smart village in 2015, still awaits promised development and basic facilities. Residents face unpaved roads and broken drainage systems, impacting daily life significantly. Some villagers propose changing the name from Sadullapur to Bharatpur hoping for development. However, other residents prioritize basic infrastructure over any name change. Development projects are currently delayed due to monsoon and religious processions.

title: Germany commercial property prices fall in Q2, break 5-quarter gains streak; here's why
content: Commercial property prices in Germany declined in the second quarter, halting a streak of five consecutive quarters of growth. This drop was largely driven by mounting inflation worries and increasing interest rates. While office and retail spaces saw a year-on-year decrease of one percent, residential properties continued their gradual appreciation. The market's outlook will be determined by the resolution of ongoing geopolitical disputes.

title: ‘Akhada, political links’: Brij Bhushan reacts to acquittal, alleges conspiracy
content: Former WFI president Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh was found not guilty in a sexual harassment case, as the court uncovered potential political agendas behind the allegations. It noted connections between the complainants, a specific wrestling akhada, and political entities. Additionally, the court scrutinised the addresses shared by complainants and mentioned that a few maintained contact with Singh after the accusations were made.

title: Ex-JPSC chairperson arrested amid student protests over alleged irregularities
content: Jharkhand CID arrested former JPSC chairperson L Khiangte for alleged recruitment exam irregularities. Protesters marched towards the state assembly demanding reforms and an independent probe. Police used water cannons and baton-charged demonstrators who breached barricades. The agitation entered its 17th day with protesters seeking CBI or retired judge investigation. Authorities imposed prohibitory orders and deployed significant security personnel along the protest route.

title: ‘Breach of trust’: UEFA, CONCACAF, AFC launch scathing attack on Infantino
content: UEFA, CONCACAF, and AFC have attacked FIFA president Gianni Infantino. They accuse him of a fundamental breach of trust over World Cup sale plans. The confederations believe this is a failure of judgment, not just communication. FIFA defended Infantino, calling the criticism an effort to undermine him. Infantino apologised for the process surrounding the World Cup proposal.

title: Jana Nayagan box office collection: Vijay film slows on 3rd Monday
content: Jana Nayagan's theatrical performance is experiencing a notable decline as it enters its third Monday, with just Rs 0.15 crore net collected on Day 19. The film did enjoy a robust third Sunday, reaching Rs 3.60 crore, boosted by numerous screenings. Monday's early occupancy reflects typical weekday trends at only 11.7 percent, though Vijay's last film before his political venture still enjoys significant fan enthusiasm.

title: Jewellery shop told to pay customer Rs 35k relief for failing to turn gold into bangles
content: A consumer commission ordered Kapoor Jewellers to return 32 grams of gold.  The jewellers failed to make new bangles from the gold provided.  They also must pay the customer Rs 35,000 for their service deficiency.  The commission found documentary evidence proved the transaction occurred.  This ruling addresses a customer's complaint about unfulfilled jewellery work.

title: 18 injured, 4 critical after unidentified men open fire along Assam-Arunachal border
content: Eighteen villagers in Assam have reportedly suffered injuries from cross-border firing that originated in Arunachal Pradesh. The incident unfolded against the backdrop of escalating tensions related to a persistent boundary dispute in Dhemaji district. In the wake of the violence, Assam officials have increased security measures, with the chief minister emphasizing the need to fortify all areas of Assam.

title: She opened her piggy bank for her brother; 5 years later, it changed his life
content: In Burhanpur, Madhya Pradesh, Mohammad Sohail Ansari’s journey from working for others to running his own clothes shop began with an unexpected investment from his elder sister. She saved money in her piggy bank and gave it to Sohail, encouraging him to start a business. Despite struggling initially, he persevered and has now been running his shop for five years, earning a steady income and supporting his family through affordable clothing sales.

title: ‘Narendra naam se nafrat’: Berwal’s Pak boxer story leaves PM Modi laughing
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi heard memorable stories from India's Commonwealth Games medalists. Boxer Narender Berwal shared an amusing anecdote about a Pakistani opponent's reaction. Jadumani Singh recounted his significant victory on Kargil Vijay Diwas. He dedicated his win to Indian Army heroes, which Modi praised. India achieved its best-ever boxing haul at the Glasgow Games.

title: Students at Nalsar oppose CJI as chief guest for convocation

Students submitted multiple representations to the administration expressing their objections.  These students feel the choice conflicts with university values and constitutional principles.  The university administration has not yet responded to the students' concerns.

title: 6 balls, 6 sixes: Batter unleashes stunning power-hitting blitz in county match
content: Toby Albert achieved six sixes in six balls during a One-Day Cup match. He scored eighty-six runs from just thirty-seven deliveries for Hampshire. Hampshire posted a massive total and secured a fifty-one-run victory over Sussex. Ben Mayes and Ali Orr also contributed centuries to the strong batting performance. Albert continues his impressive form with two fifties in three tournament matches.

title: ITR filing: How to track your tax refund status online
content: ITR refund status: A refund arises when the income tax that you have paid exceeds your final tax liability. This can be due to excess TDS, TCS, advance tax, self-assessment tax, deductions, exemptions, or treaty-based relief claimed in the return.

title: Land ownership titles in India explained: What they mean and how they differ
content: Navigating the property market involves grasping different land titles and their significance. Freehold ownership is the most straightforward, providing easily transferable rights. In contrast, leasehold ownership offers usage for a defined duration under specific terms. Various state tenures such as Patta, Bhumidhari, and Raiyati rights come with their own legal guidelines. Lastly, ownership in apartment and cooperative societies introduces unique management and ownership dynamics.
